regulator: BC College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM)

requirements.name: NNAS Advisory Report
requirements.detail: Same national gateway as other Canadian provinces; report is shared with BCCNM.

requirements.name: English proficiency (IELTS Academic / CELBAN)
requirements.detail: Required where prior education/practice was not in English.

requirements.name: BCCNM registration application
requirements.detail: Apply to BCCNM; assessment may require a competence assessment (e.g. NCAS).

requirements.name: NCLEX-RN
requirements.detail: National licensure exam; eligibility via BCCNM.

notes: BC often uses NCAS (Nursing Community Assessment Service) as a competence assessment step in addition to NNAS.
